backend/main.mo: Motoko actor storing contact form submissions in a list and exposing submit and retrieval functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for numerous frontend React files used elsewhere in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light/dark mode including global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point loading the React app and defining page metadata.
frontend/PUBLISHING.md: Build and deployment guide covering asset checks, configuration validation, and IC deployment steps.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling all site sections with theme support and global UI elements.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section with company overview, feature cards, and CTAs for quote, WhatsApp, and call actions.
frontend/src/components/Certificates.tsx: Certificates section displaying the Udyam Registration Certificate with preview, details, and download options.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Implements a contact section with a form, quick-call/WhatsApp CTAs, and contact info cards, submitting data via a custom query hook. Handles form state, validation, and success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/electrician-anim: SVG scene illustrating emergency repair with optional animations disabled when reduced motion is enabled.
SVG animation of an MCB switch toggling on/off, respecting reduced‑motion settings.
SVG scene showing animated panel wiring with flowing wires and spark effects, respecting reduced‑motion mode.
SVG switchboard installation animation featuring rotating screws and a moving screwdriver with reduced‑motion fallback.
SVG tester‑checking animation with a moving voltage tester, blinking LED, and voltage display.
frontend/src/components/ElectricianWorkA: Renders a grid of electrician work animation cards, using scenes or fallback media depending on reduced‑motion preference. Includes titles, descriptions, and a premium emergency repair animation.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Shows floating call and WhatsApp action buttons once the user scrolls past 300px. Clicking triggers phone dialing or opens a WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays company info, quick navigation links, and contact details, plus a copyright bar with a caffeine.ai attribution link. Supports smooth scrolling via section navigation.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides a fixed responsive header with a top contact bar, WhatsApp button, and mobile menu. Tracks scroll state for styling and enables section navigation with smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Builds the homepage hero with animated/static background media, AMC highlight, branding, and CTAs for WhatsApp and contact navigation. Emphasizes key service messaging and animated entrance effects.
frontend/src/components/Products.tsx: Defines a product list with price formatting and renders product cards including WhatsApp and scroll actions.
frontend/src/components/ReducedMotionMed: Displays either an animated or static image based on the user's reduced‑motion preference.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Renders core and additional service cards with images, descriptions, and WhatsApp/contact actions.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Shows a testimonials section with star ratings and customer reviews.
frontend/src/components/WorkVideo.tsx: Provides a video and image‑montage player with upload, playback, customization, and recording features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, stored identity loading, and AuthClient configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useMontagePlayer.ts: Controls slideshow playback state with timers, allowing play, pause, restart, and timing adjustments.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Hook detecting the user's prefers‑reduced‑motion setting via a media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React‑query hooks for submitting contact forms and retrieving submissions using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base and theme configuration defining color tokens, dark mode variables, animations, and layout utilities.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports branding constants including business name, city, and a generated emergency‑electrician tagline.
frontend/src/lib/montageRecorder.ts: Provides canvas-based video montage recording with transitions, handling MediaRecorder setup, image loading, and animated rendering.
frontend/src/lib/scroll.ts: Implements smooth scrolling to page sections while adjusting for dynamic header height.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp Business chat URLs with optional encoded messages for a predefined number.
frontend/src/lib/workVideoPhotos.ts: Exports a list of default work photo asset paths used in the montage generator.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with react-query and Internet Identity provider wrappers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, plugins, colors, and container settings for the project.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, known issues, and feature requests related to video upload and montage reliability.
